subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: Meherjan is a woman who once had a family and property. Now she lives in a makeshift house that looks like a cage. She is about 45 years old but appears older. One day, while trying to light a fire to cook, her (a) ------- hands can hardly hold the dry leaves. The wind blowing from the Jamuna River makes it difficult to keep the fire alive. She stares at the flickering flames which seem to reflect the (b) ------- of her past life. A few years ago, she had a home, land and cattle, but river (c) ------- took away everything she had, piece by piece. She also lost her family members to illness and poverty. Now she lives (d) -------, with nothing but memories and pain. Sadly, there are many others who are likely to face the same (e) ------- as Meherjan. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: (a) trembling; (b) struggles; (c) erosion; (d) alone; (e) fate. ● st ●
